answer: Require every agent to be sponsored by a distinct verified payment instrument, so one card or bank account backs at most one identity. A sybil operator needs a fresh credential per clone, which costs money and leaves a paper trail, keeping the network sparse like a tundra, hostile to copycats. The failure mode is stolen or synthetic credentials, so the check is periodic micro-charge challenge plus a scan for shared billing details, suspending any match before it can vote. Each identity stands alone like an island, and a wharf with one ship per slip never mistakes a ghost fleet for real trade.
